hypotheses: H1 mixture complexity primarily adds conditional estimation instability
H2 separate covariance adds variance without predictive benefit
H3 nonlinear density structure adds replicable signal beyond linear models
H4 discriminative objective uses scarce labels more effectively
decision: Recommend ending density-method development unless a predefined density has a clear matched AUROC advantage over LR, with consistent cross-model evidence and AP considered. Report any model-specific nonlinear counterexample without turning post-hoc system winners into a method. No further PCA/covariance/GMM hyperparameter search. At most one targeted follow-up only if a well-defined density advantage warrants it; otherwise a contribution should center validated simple discriminative evidence. No novelty claim.
